gloss: peak season; busy period; period of flourishing business

definitions.gloss: peak season; busy period; period of flourishing business

examples.japanese: ⟦{夏|なつ}→夏：02236_natsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{観光地|かんこうち}→観光地：14163_kankouchi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{繁盛期|はんじょうき}だ。
examples.english: Summer is peak season for tourist areas.

examples.japanese: {繁盛期|はんじょうき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦アルバイト→アルバイト：01528_arubaito⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{増|ふ}やす→増やす：02410_fuyasu⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: During the busy season, we need to hire more part-time workers.

examples.japanese: ⟦{年末年始|ねんまつねんし}→年末年始：12457_nenmatsunenshi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{飲食店|いんしょくてん}→飲食店：15093_inshokuten⟧⟦にとって→にとって：06803_nitotte⟧⟦{最|もっと}も→最も：01736_mottomo⟧⟦{忙|いそが}しい→忙しい：00591_isogashii⟧{繁盛期|はんじょうき}で⟦あり→ある：00006_aru⟧、⟦{予約|よやく}→予約：01522_yoyaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{取|と}り→取る：00565_toru⟧にくく⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: The year-end and New Year period is the busiest peak season for restaurants, making reservations hard to get.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{繁盛|はんじょう}→繁盛：09614_hanjou⟧ (prosperity, flourishing business) + {期|き} (period). Refers to a time when business activity peaks, often due to seasonal demand.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{観光|かんこう}→観光：00173_kankou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{繁盛期|はんじょうき}: peak tourism season
- {繁盛期|はんじょうき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{迎|むか}える→迎える：01193_mukaeru⟧: to enter the busy season
- {繁盛期|はんじょうき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{備|そな}える→備える：02125_sonaeru⟧: to prepare for the busy season

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{繁忙期|はんぼうき}→繁忙期：08366_hanbouki⟧: busy period — more broadly used for any hectic time, not just business prosperity
- ⟦{閑散期|かんさんき}→閑散期：08367_kansanki⟧: slow season, off-season — the opposite
- ⟦{最盛期|さいせいき}→最盛期：13058_saiseiki⟧: peak period — emphasizes the height of activity or production, used more broadly beyond business
